title: Senior Clerk

about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, an established organisation in the transport industry, for a highly organised and detail-oriented Senior Clerk to work as a depot administrator supporting daily depot operations in Floriana.

You will give administrative and operational support to Depot Management: keeping accurate records, handling communication with drivers and staff, and processing employee documentation, compliance records and operational reports on time. The work ranges from attendance, leave and payroll queries to disciplinary records, infringements, incident reports, purchase orders and CPC training bookings.

The role suits someone with strong administrative skills who can manage several tasks at once in a fast-paced operational environment. It is a full-time, Monday-to-Friday position from 8:00 am to 4:30 pm, paying €18,015 per year.
responsibilities: Provide daily administrative support to Depot Management and operational teams
Prepare, distribute and maintain operational notices, including service updates and diversions
Process and maintain employee attendance records, sick certificates, leave documentation and payroll-related information
Record employee payroll queries and follow them up with the relevant departments
Prepare and maintain disciplinary documentation, warning letters and other employee records in line with company procedures
Administer operational infringements, fines and related compliance documentation
Conduct and record driver alcohol tests according to established procedures
Assist with preparing and submitting accident, injury and incident reports
Prepare purchase orders, keep purchasing records and monitor office and operational supplies
Maintain driver fare deposit records and prepare reports on cancelled tickets
Coordinate driver training bookings, including Certificate of Professional Competence (CPC) training
Manage Lost and Found records, making sure items are registered, safeguarded and returned when appropriate
Maintain cleaning schedules, timesheets and related documentation
Prepare regular reports on attendance, disciplinary matters, compliance, financial administration and other depot activities
Keep all administrative records accurate, organised, confidential and up to date
requirements: Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word
Good written and verbal communication skills in both Maltese and English
Strong attention to detail and accuracy in record-keeping
Good communication, interpersonal and teamwork skills
Ability to prioritise tasks and work efficiently in a busy environment
Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to daily responsibilities
Ability to handle confidential information professionally
Basic reporting skills and the ability to monitor operational performance indicators
